scientific_integrity: Direct finite-dimensional analytic proof plus standalone exact symbolic identities and independent sampled density-matrix checks; infinite-index statements are proved analytically, not inferred from finite checks.
scientific_limitations: Applies to maximally mixed initial system; ideal repeated identical anti-exchange two-qubit unitary; diagonal identically polarized fresh ancilla and complete reset; pre-reset system--ancilla negativity, not experimental noisy conditions or steady-state entanglement. The population map and general two-qubit entangleability/PPT criteria are prior results. Priority of the fully explicit trajectory may require independent literature review.
title: Exact polarization threshold and logarithmic entanglement lifetime in anti-thermalizing qubit collisions
